description: Loads an existing PauseScreen JavaScript file in Jellyfin Web clients without modifying Jellyfin Web files.
name: Jellyfin-PauseScreen
overview: A pause screen for jellyfin that adds the logo and the disc and the description when paused that dissapears when playback is resumed or the video is exited.

versions.changelog: Use ES2017-compatible JavaScript for LG webOS 5.x/6.x while retaining the Jellyfin 12 authentication fix.
Fix Jellyfin 12 API authentication for session lookups.
